name: orb_15min_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the 09:15-09:29 opening range compresses into a tight band (0.3-1.5% of index price, roughly 60-300 points), it signals that FII/DII desks and domestic algo participants are in genuine price discovery equilibrium — neither side has printed a decisive gap or directional bias. This condensed coiled state means that the first close above the ORB high with a volume surge (>1.5x the 20-minute rolling average) represents a decisive supply-ceiling break: an institutional buy program has cleared the ask-side resting orders that defined the upper bound, and the same algorithms that created the range now accelerate the breakout as their sell-stop orders above are triggered and VWAP-benchmark algos scramble to avoid tracking error. The tight range also means the breakout signal has lower noise than wide-ORB days where price action is already directional from the open.
core_signal_oneliner: 15-minute ORB breakout with 2-bar persistence, 1.5x volume surge, and OR width filter (0.3-1.5%) selecting coiled-spring sessions only, with entries restricted to 09:30-12:00
